Colors are important to make the interface easy to remember and use-each component has a unique palette to make it easier for users to identify elements and perform actions.

I chose Plus Jakarta Sans for its approachable character and excellent legibility at both large headings and small labels. Its slightly rounded letterforms strike a balance between modern minimalism and a warm, human touch.
